/health events are emitted on a state change (or first ok after a deploy) at probe time.
X events: 17 from x-ledger.jsonl (herald's machine ledger).
Order: (UTC instant, kind rank, id). Same id from two sources: API > x-ledger > light-notes > --merge-x.
